{{Top|leg}}
'''Travel vouchers''' were permits that allowed the bearers free travel aboard any non-military Imperial [[Starship/Legends|starship]].They were issued to members of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Sub-Adult Group/Legends|SAGroup]].<ref name="HR">''[[Heroes & Rogues]]''</ref> [[Muftak/Legends|Muftak]] and [[Kabe/Legends|Kabe]] were able to leave the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] using two stolen travel vouchers signed by [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]].<ref name="EGTC">''[[The Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref>
